intro: Clermont is made to be your private theatre at home. With silent reclining, leather-touch upholstery, and an embedded coffee table, it’s the best choice for indulgent relaxation and cinematic comfort.

features.title: Pure touch and premium finish
features.text: Wrapped in premium leather-touch upholstery, the Clermont recliner blends plush comfort with elegant style and long-lasting durability.

features.title: Your perfect spot, just a tilt away
features.text: The manual reclining mechanism adjusts up to 140 degrees, letting you find your ideal position for ultimate relaxation at the touch of a lever.

features.title: Comfort at every perfect angle
features.text: The tall backrest provides full support to your head and spine, making this recliner the perfect choice for movie nights or relaxation.

features.title: Made to cradle, built to last
features.text: Reclon-filled armrests cradle your arms gently, giving you the ergonomic support you need for long sitting or lounging sessions.

features.title: Solid wood frame for lasting durability
features.text: Built to stand the test of time, the solid wood frame offers unmatched durability and strength. Designed for everyday use, it provides sturdy support while maintaining its elegance for years.

name: Clermont 1-Seater Leatherette Recliner
